listing.name: Tales of Xillia 2 — TOX2-recomp (yuias)
listing.summary: Experimental project. Title/opening scenes picture/sound on Mac; an attract-movie placeholder, physical gamepad testing on Mac and full playthrough absent. These are the project’s reports; See below for original-file requirements and setup. Portcove has not confirmed setup or gameplay.

steps.title: Check the required game files
steps.instruction: Use your own Japanese PS3 BLJS10188 EBOOT and PUP4.93. Check the executable and libsre against the pinned hashes. Keep your original game files separately. The recorded source review did not download or run the game.

steps.title: Follow upstream setup
steps.instruction: Use your own EBOOT/PUP decryption and PPU/SPU staticemit then build tox2_game; first config fetches key-bearing RPCS3source, offline alternative. These are manual setup instructions. Portcove does not manage this download or confirm setup or gameplay.

warnings: The project reports title and opening scenes with picture and sound on Mac. The note also mentions an attract-movie placeholder; physical gamepad testing on Mac and a full playthrough have not been recorded. Portcove has not confirmed setup or gameplay.
Portcove has not confirmed setup, gameplay, saves or updates for this experimental port.
